match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: Scarlett catches the lipstick, pockets it, and walks toward the glowing skyline. Framing: low angle, low angle, The rooftop ledge and lipstick sit in the foreground while Scarlett's silhouette moves toward the glowing skyline, ending with her coral lips catching warm light. Placement only, not the pose: Scarlett has just placed the closed lipstick on the ledge and stands beside it, facing the skyline as wind nudges the tube toward the edge. Camera, as one or two arrows: truck, gradual. Characters: Scarlett, Female, 20s, A sharp-eyed young woman of medium height, A sleek black turtleneck with a streamlined black-and-neutral. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
